name: pillars
title: Pillars
description: A field of white-capped cylinders, row behind row. Under the pointer they rise in a smoothed pyramid, most beneath it and less around, bodies showing between the caps, and settle back as it moves on.
docs: One self-contained file, react only: no Tailwind, no other dependency. Mount <Pillars /> inside an element with position: relative and a size; it covers that element and is decoration only: give it no link or click handler. Suggested commit: feat: add Pillars hover texture (textures.dev/s/pillars)
